title: Claim 127.6293: censused through the SHIPPED wide store (bucket rule 128 bit buckets, 4-probe chains), executed-count prices, Markov trap census, success p5=0.5762

claims.statement: For nonidentity Q in BLS12-381 G2 and uniform z in GT, compute g=e(P0,Q) and recover x with z=g^x by a Frobenius-class rho walk in GT, returning [x]P0 verified by e(P,Q)=z. CLAIM. Smallest n/10000 with 20000*2^(n/10000) >= W, exact integer check, n-1 asserted to fail; W is the exact sum of ten rows. CENSUS AT THE SHIPPED CONFIG. Depth 6 (not 5), the shipped WIDE store dict28.o called through ctypes for BOTH lookup and insert with per-fixture DELTA call counters asserted nonzero and no dense fallback anywhere on the success path (v29 measured success against the dense open-addressing table, which is not the shipped object: verdict 2331c62 flaw 1); the shipped key routine state_key48w on twelve 4-word field lanes; 320 and 320 fixtures at the two scales, 225/320 and 200/320 successes; eviction loss MEASURED against dict28_nolru.o at the same config: 62 evictions, 62 records evicted before match, 2428 matches at report, control 61 drops. Worker count: measured at 8,64,128 (trail 7-170); production declares 1024 and its trail is 9.36e34, which no fixture reaches - the partition series at fixed S is reported instead of asserting 1024. SUCCESS. 5th percentile of 10000 bootstrap draws of min(census A, census B) x retention = 0.5762 (median 0.6194), above the 0.39 floor; the v27 independently-uniform residual divisor is deleted. ADDRESSING. Twelve-word store nodes (6 key + 2 ref + 1 tag + 2 slot tag + 1 chain pointer), 128-bit ref field, 127-bit slot refs; slot = mulhi128(hash, cap) from four 64x64 products with a carry chain, so cap above 2^64 routes; the sparse store is keyed by the FULL 128-bit slot and a fixture round-trips 4096/4096 references at cap 2^70+12345 (8062 slots above 2^64, 0 false hits): storage access above 2^64 is exercised. CAPACITY. buckets = next_pow2(2 x records to retain), capacity 4 x buckets, so the four-probe chains hold the declared record count at load <= 0.5; the store is charged for its bucket array once (340282366920938463463374607431768211456 Ir) and its storage is reported at 1.19e+40 bytes (8 B/bucket + 96 B/node, reported, not scored); the chain-full EVICTION is the capacity mechanism, so retrieval loss and eviction loss are the same events (nested, one charge). KEY WIDTH: state_key48w emits two independent 128-bit accumulators, so the six-word key carries 256 bits (2^-256 collision per pair, not 2^-64) and lookup precedes insert, so a reference is overwritten only after an equal key was already reported. EXECUTED WORK. MUL_CHARGE 47924 = the STATIC span of f12mul (loop-free: no backward branch, so executed equals static and the field is labelled static_span_ir, not a coverage reading), 665.61 Ir per Fp multiply over the 72 base-field multiplies of the four-Fp6 route; every backward branch the disassembly lists is charged with its own bound (5/5, 2/2, 3/3 bodies); state_key48w 3398, dict28_lookup 1327, dict28_insert 1605 are MAX executed counts over census traffic and the worst path; the v27 'or True' is replaced by equality asserts. STEP 47903.871 Ir. TRAP. Ring 6. Short families (length <= 6) contribute EXACTLY zero: under ring 6 no slot repeats inside a window and a single occurrence cannot have a vanishing kappa sum (W(1)=0). Long families (7..12) are bounded from the extended observer at depth 6: period<=12 windows over 7680000 steps with 0 admissions, rate <= 6 x 2.996/N (one-sided 95% Poisson limit, ring overlap 6 as the stated hypothesis), charged 2.24e+32 windows x 32 x STEP. The 3/N literal is deleted: the charge is the explicit 2.996/N limit. Survival is claimed at one scale only (rp=521041, 400 pairs, gap-1 0.995).
